propositions: Bounded recovery rejects contexts over 24,000 chars before attempting recovery, blocking correctly-merged work with large ticket text from reaching closed status
Step-budget exhaustion incorrectly reports 'install the agents extra' remedy despite the model having run, because recovery_failure_cause returns None for CompletionRecoveryError
Context cap (24,000) is incoherent with criteria cap (32,000), allowing criteria sets passing all criteria bounds but failing context validation
Compaction of oversized context by dropping comment history deletes entire child tickets on epic closes while misreporting it as comment elision, creating signed-false-pass risk
Raising the context bound to 100,000 chars with no elision covers real blocked tickets (34,282 and 41,595 chars) while preserving zero-billable-call cost guard on breach
Remedy selection must use exception cause rather than exception type to avoid false guidance when demonstrable model execution occurred
